name: Meamea Fo Rusalka
original_name: メアメア・フォ・ルサールカ
source:
[u][b]The Shy Little Sister-like Succubus Oppai Bunny!♥[/b][/u]
Race: Succubus (Fallsregina Tribe)
First Year at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy
Secret Hot Springs Exploration Club Member

A first-year student at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy, a girl of the Succubus race. At first glance, she seems like a fragile, shy girl, but she’s actually a free-spirited girl who moves quickly based on energy, momentum, and intuition. Toward the protagonist, she also shows a straightforward and selfish side.

She loves sweets and is easily swayed if sweets are dangled in front of her or if the protagonist pats her head.

She often calls the protagonist "Onii-chan".

She is very naive about the world and often shows off only to dig herself into a hole.

Although it’s hard to imagine from her appearance, she eagerly listens to dirty jokes and lewd stories with sparkling eyes, like an overly curious kid. (Maybe that's due to her succubus bloodline?)

She belongs to the rare Hot Spring Succubus tribe, the Fallsregina tribe, who draw magical power from hot springs. (Though strangely, her family’s actual business is running an adult goods shop.) Although [url=/c146728]Giltia[/url], the second-year public morals committee member, is also a succubus, she is from a different succubus race. Additionally, when she gets into a hot spring, her racial instincts kick in and she ends up going into heat. (Her tone turns into something akin to a mischievous brat.)

She belongs to the Secret Hot Spring Exploration Club, which makes use of her racial traits. (For the sake of improving her skills.) There is an open-air bath inside the academy grounds, and it can also be used by non-club students. The club advisor is the protagonist.

Her hobbies are visiting secret hot springs and taking long baths, and her favorite things are coffee (no sugar, with milk), cocoa, and getting head pats.
